note: Recurring series for the keeper (docs/SERIES.md). Copy this file, set KEEPER_SERIES_FILE to the copy, and turn creation on with KEEPER_SERIES_ENABLED=1 (KEEPER_ENABLED must be on too). Blocks and assets below are for Monad testnet. The two funding series carry a seed: right after creating each market, the keeper stakes for our maker and our guardian from its own USDC (on testnet, minted from the TestUSDC faucet), so the pool meets the testnet rule (100 USDC from 3 stakers) and graduates on its own. The seed is our own money and is logged as ours.

series.note: Will BTC longs pay more than the median of the last 8 weeks' net funding this week? About 7 days of blocks at 302 ms.
Will ETH/USD be at or above today's price, rounded to 25 USD, at 12:00 UTC? Off here: Monad testnet's Chainlink feeds update about once a day, so price markets there usually void.
Will Chainlink's BTC/USD feed report 5% above the price at creation, rounded up to 500 USD, at any time this week? Off on testnet for the same reason.
Will any single MON funding event in the next day charge longs more than the 98th percentile of the last 600 events? About 24 hours of blocks.
Will ETH/USD be inside the 100 USD band around the price at creation at 18:00 UTC? Off on testnet for the same reason.
